profileParagraphs: Situated among the scenic and tranquil Western Ghats, Leksa Lighting is a company founded in 2018, with the vision and the determination to deliver Lighting Excellence across India and the world. Our business portfolio caters to the lighting of both professional and consumer spaces. We are renowned for providing turn-key solutions and we have successfully completed 800+ projects globally. We offer a wide range of innovative LED lamps and fixtures, with specialized knowledge in Stage Lighting & Drapery, Architectural and Façade lighting, DJ & Pub Lighting, Stadium, Video Conference, TV Studio & General Lights.

To maintain the highest standards, a well-equipped and organized world-class manufacturing unit has been set up in Mangalore, India. This Manufacturing Facility is spread over 80,000 sqft, Qualified Professional Team of 225+ have scattered across India for better service support, 15+ Verticals combined with over 500+ Lighting Products, The company has an expansive network of 10 Branch Offices, 20+ Global Sales Network, combined with over 500+ Lighting Products.

We have an in-house Photometric Lab, well equipped SMT Lab, Research & Development Centre, IP Testing Facility, Fabrication & Powder Coating Facility and in-house Experience Centre. Constant innovation and significant performance by our team have led to us achieving milestones in a row and fortifying its dominant presence in the Lighting Sector.

ourTeamParagraphs: An award winning Lighting Manufacturer of India – LEKSA LIGHTING Technologies Pvt Ltd., Established in 2017, in Mangalore, India. In just few years, Leksa Lighting has become a reputed manufacturer by adapting Japanese production systems and work culture. Currently Leksa lighting is a leading manufacturer of professional lighting in Southeast Asia.

A highly professional team has geared up with one motto “Respect for people and Team work” under the able leadership of Mr. Ronald Silvan D’Souza – Founder & Executive Director, an excellent Leader and Team Player. In such a short time Leksa has executed projects all over India and also has spread its presence across 20+ countries and has one of the largest manufacturing facilities in Southeast Asia. With our unprecedented growth in this competitive market, we have shown our hunger for excellence and success and no obstacle will hinder Leksa Lighting in getting to that mission.
directorMessageParagraphs: As an Executive Director of Leksa Lighting, I am pleased to welcome you to our company website and here I would like to take this opportunity to share a few thoughts with you. When we founded Leksa Lighting in 2018, the major focus was on TRANSFORMING SPECIALISED LIGHTING IN A PROFESSIONAL MANNER for the entertainment industry in terms of quality, cost and in providing the best service to the country. Since then, we have been dedicated to make sure our customers are our FIRST priority. Today we are the only company in India with the experience of providing Specialized Lighting with well-equipped and organized world-class manufacturing unit in Mangalore, India. I also recognized that commitment to quality and project management along with loyalty to our customers would be the major contributing factor to our great success.

Over the years, we have moved from a single vertical to becoming a one stop shop for our customer security, environment needs and requirements. Today we have 15+ lighting verticals under Leksa lighting serving high end Corporates and the public sector with complete satisfaction. Good people make good products, our focus has been always to create good people, so in just a few years, adapting Japanese technology and work culture, Leksa has become one of the renowned and leading manufacturer of professional lighting in Southeast Asia winning many awards. Today we have successfully completed prestigious projects all over India and 20+ countries.

Progress for me has never been a dream. It has always been a distant reality and once one milestone is achieved, there is always another one waiting to be crossed. It is with this belief that we started LEXRISE, another feather added to the Lighting excellence of LEKSA, which got introduced to the market by end March 2023. Brand LEXRISE includes General Lights, Aurea Lights, Argil Lights, Combo Lights and Bollards & Designer Lights.

We comprehend that it is only our quality of services that have over the years, delighted our customers. We have continued to make investments in people and technology to automate processes and systems which will help us scale the business faster and be more responsive to the needs of our customers. We believe that a key reason for our success has been our ability to understand the rapidly changing needs of the industry, clients and being at the forefront of these changes through constant innovations in design and technology in our product offerings. Let this Trusted Brand grow with your kind patronage.
